target_customer: Military units, starting with soldiers carrying heavy combat loads, with Ukrainian operators as first testers
problem: Soldiers burn large effort carrying combat loads. Edgerun builds a 10 lb powered hip exoskeleton claimed to cut effort 30 to 45 percent.

founders.name: David Venegas
founders.background_notes: YC bio calls him a pro-human expansionist, state-championship runner, adventure athlete and pilot.

competitors.name: Lockheed Martin FORTIS
competitors.what: Passive knee-stress exoskeleton tested by US Army
competitors.traction_then: Army evaluation with soldiers, nine percent energy reduction reported

competitors.name: Hypershell X
competitors.what: Active consumer exoskeleton evaluated for mountain military use

competitors.name: Other Ukrainian exoskeleton developers
competitors.what: Ukraine opened a race and grants to build combat exoskeletons

technical_complexity.rationale: Wearable actuation with battery life over 12 hours claimed, plus field-hardening for combat, is hardware research-grade for a small team; independent studies found passive units can slow soldiers.

defensibility.rationale: Several programs exist; field data with Ukrainian units and integration with armor maker Balistyka are early signals only.

market_need_then: Ukraine's military is testing exoskeletons and the government has opened a race and grants for combat exoskeletons, per 2026 coverage.

branding.name_origin: Company site says the name comes from the edgerunner, a character type in Mike Pondsmith's 1988 tabletop universe, who refuses to be replaced by machines.
branding.domain_note: Owns edgerun.com. A USPTO application for EDGERUN was filed 2026-01-28 by Edgerun Industries, Inc.

identity.logo: Edgerun Industries logo file; design not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold and heroic: strike harder, last longer, go farther

branding.brand_signature: Edgerunner mythos and the operate at the edge line

brand_strength.rationale: Clear sourced name story and a launch covered by Runtime Wire, but it shares its name with an AI startup called EdgeRunner AI and the Cyberpunk anime.

outcome_analysis: Edgerun is an Active Summer 2026 company launched in August 2026 with company-reported results from over 100 field tests in Ukraine. There is no outcome yet. Key risks are hardware difficulty, military procurement cycles and independent studies showing exoskeleton benefits are uneven.
notes: No funding found. Team size differs between sources (YC page 12, listing summary 8, job board 20 to 50). Founded year 2026 is inferred from job board join date and trademark filing, not a stated incorporation date. Performance claims are the company's own. Only one founder is named on the YC page.
